features.statement: Page has exactly one h1 heading, large and bold, forming a clear heading outline.
Headings use bold sans-serif (Helvetica-style) while body paragraphs use serif Georgia, a two-family pairing.
Palette is forest green with gold accent, with dark green-gray text instead of pure black.
Page background is warm cream, with sections alternating cream and white separated by hairline gray rules.
Hero is a single darkened background photo with overlaid live white h1, serif subtitle and a call-to-action button.
Header is slim: a dark utility bar above a single white nav bar with small logo, few links and cart pill.
Cards, tiles and images use large rounded corners with no pill shapes; product cards have thin borders.
Feature images have soft, large-blur drop shadows.
Feature rows alternate image left and right, with text placed directly on the background without card panels.
Content sits in a narrower centered container with generous side margins.
Sale badges are small gold pills placed inline beside the price.
Section headings are centered and item titles inside card rows are h3 headings.
Pull quotes are rendered as blockquote with an accent-colored left rule and italic text.
Newsletter signup is a dedicated full-width colored band with centered input and accent-colored button.
Social links are text-labelled outline pills rather than icon-only circles.
Footer is dark, keeps copyright above a hairline divider, and shows payment icons on a white rounded panel.
Footer contact lines bold only the labels, with regular-weight values.
Link lists sit in a plain white section with bold heading and small underlined links.
Includes a collapsible details/summary disclosure for browsing topics.
Uses CSS grid and lean markup: few classes, one style block, minimal scripts, few ARIA and inline styles.
Strikethrough prices use the s tag rather than del/ins.
Images have descriptive alt text matching their content and the page title is short.
Copy is calm with few exclamation marks and no emoji.
Few transitions and no animations or transforms; interactions are minimal.
Editorial news article appears as a narrow left-aligned column mid-page with a gold small-caps eyebrow label.
